doc.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025

title: Producer philosophy and the dishonest producer on RCA
summary: Orrin Keepnews's definition, and how Phil's producer padded RCA budgets until he was found out and removed.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Orrin Keepnews — I asked him if he had a definition or a philosophy about producing and he said, he described it as being a catalytic agent creating a circumstance where an artist can work most effectively.

That’s a good way of putting it. But you know what it really boiled down to me was being able to relate to the musicians and to the business of music. See for a long time I didn’t relate to music as a business. I just did it and I made money at it. I wasn’t that aware of the greater music business. But then when we were working with this producer with Phil and then they had a big falling out because it turns out the guy was padding the budgets and keeping the money. He was basically stealing. And he’s dead now so I won’t defame him any further than necessary.
Yeah because you mentioned he might be making ten times more than the musicians and I’m wondering who’s paying the producer? Is it the record label?
Well we were on RCA Records so he was getting big budgets for us and he was spending only half of the money and keeping the rest.
So now you’re in the producer’s —
The producer found out and got rid of him.
Yeah. So now you’re in the producer’s chair and you are dealing with the budget.
